title: Sunny and the Baby Echidna
description: Little Sonny the quokka finds a tiny baby echidna all curled up on the path. A warm, tender bedtime story for little ones. Part of Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales.
narration:
One afternoon, Sunny was taking his usual quiet walk along the little dirt path through the bush.

He wasn't in a hurry. He never was. He liked to walk slowly, and notice things.

And today, he noticed something very small.

Right there on the path, curled up into a tiny ball of soft spikes, was the smallest echidna Sunny had ever seen.

Sunny stopped. He tilted his head to the side.

The little echidna didn't move. It was all tucked in, safe inside its own little world.

Sunny sat down beside it, very quietly, so as not to startle it.

He waited.

After a moment, one tiny eye peeked open.

The baby echidna looked at Sunny. Sunny looked at the baby echidna.

Sunny gave his gentlest smile.

Slowly, slowly, the little echidna began to uncurl. First a little snout appeared, long and delicate. Then four small sturdy legs. Then a round little body covered in the softest, smallest spikes Sunny had ever seen.

The baby echidna wobbled to its feet and blinked in the afternoon light.

Sunny didn't say anything. Sometimes the kindest thing was just to be there.

They sat together for a while, the little echidna and Sunny, while the afternoon sun moved slowly through the trees and the bush hummed its soft, familiar song.

Eventually, the baby echidna gave a small, contented snuffle, turned around, and trundled off into the undergrowth. Safe. Ready. On its way.

Sunny watched it go, his heart feeling very full.

He sat on the path a little longer, listening to the quiet, feeling the warmth of the sun on his fur.

Then he turned and headed home too, stepping slowly and carefully along the path.

Goodnight, little Sunny. Goodnight, baby echidna. Goodnight, gentle bush.
